usedFor: Financial Cents holds clients and contacts for accountants, and Sangam CRM tracks sales through “Create Opportunity”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Financial Cents, then “Create Opportunity” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A new client can open a sales opportunity with custom fields and a next follow-up date.

watchOut: “Delete Client” and “Update Client” are triggers too, so choose “New Client” or removals will open opportunities.
